title: CYBRIK alert-summarization result v1
description: Result of an alert-summarization inference. The summary is UNTRUSTED, advisory analyst-support content — never an authorization, triage-decision authority, or action trigger. Citations bind each claim back to the digest-bound alert refs (grounding/provenance). Runtime invariant (control-enforced, not schema): output data_marking MUST be >= the union of the input alerts' markings — a summary never downgrades sensitivity. A refusal/filter is surfaced as outcome, not dropped. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED (v0.1.0).

tenant_id.description: Control-written authoritative tenant. Never from model output.

summary_text.description: The generated summary. Advisory analyst-support text with NO authority. Present for outcome='completed'; absent/empty otherwise.

citations.description: Grounding: each cited alert bound by digest-bound objectRef back to the request's alert_refs. Enables provenance/eval and discourages ungrounded claims.

data_marking.description: Authoritative marking of the summary output. MUST be >= the union of input alert markings (control-enforced non-downgrade).
